attribution.name: 郑覃
attribution.note: Proposed the project in 830 and led the collation of the classics.
attribution.noteZh: 大和四年（830）提议校定六经，奉命主持刻经。

attribution.name: 艾居晦、陈玠、段绛等
attribution.nameEn: Ai Juhui, Chen Jie, Duan Jiang and others
attribution.note: Four officials brushed the text; the page names Ai Juhui and Chen Jie.
attribution.noteZh: 由艾居晦、陈玠、段绛等四人书石；所引页面点名校书者为艾、陈二人。

backgroundZh: 唐人将十二部儒家经典刻上石面，共用一百一十四石。经籍于是既可传抄，也可就石校读。西安碑林将这座石上书库收入第一展室。
background: The surviving Tang stone edition of twelve Confucian classics, carved on 114 stones and kept in the first exhibition room of the Beilin. The museum describes it as the largest surviving stone “library” of its kind.

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft work record from the museum page. No compiler or scribe is recorded here because the page names none.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：依据馆方页面整理的草稿；页面未记撰书人，故不列属名。

notes: The page gives the number of stones, faces, and characters but no list of the individual colophons.
